name: electrical
description: Wiring, sockets, lights and fuse boxes: fixing and fitting.

appointmentWindowHours.description: How wide the arrival window is, in hours: the seller arrives within this many hours of the booked time.

howDealsGo: The buyer books a visit and pays into escrow. Done is the fault fixed or the fitting working, tested with the electrician there, and the buyer releases then. A timer to the seller, set past the visit, pays for work done if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, ask whether the work needs a certificate where you live.
